title: Section 34 Arbitration Act — Set aside the award - educational example

content.body: Educational example, not an official statutory illustration and not a decided case. Use only the law already recorded in this topic file. Recorded point for Section 34 Arbitration Act — Set aside the award: Section 34 is the only court recourse against a domestic award. It is not an appeal on facts.
